title: Sale
statementMd:
Once Bob got to a sale of old TV sets. There were $*n*$ TV sets at that sale. TV set with index $*i*$ costs $*a*_{*i*}$ bellars. Some TV sets have a negative price — their owners are ready to pay Bob if he buys their useless apparatus. Bob can «buy» any TV sets he wants. Though he's very strong, Bob can carry at most $*m*$ TV sets, and he has no desire to go to the sale for the second time. Please, help Bob find out the maximum sum of money that he can earn.

## Input

The first line contains two space-separated integers $*n*$ and $*m*$ ($1 ≤ *m* ≤ *n* ≤ 100$) — amount of TV sets at the sale, and amount of TV sets that Bob can carry. The following line contains $*n*$ space-separated integers $*a*_{*i*}$ ($- 1000 ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ 1000$) — prices of the TV sets.

## Output

Output the only number — the maximum sum of money that Bob can earn, given that he can carry at most $*m*$ TV sets.
statementZhMd:
<statement>
鲍勃来到了一个旧电视机的售卖活动现场。那里有 $*n*$ 台电视机。编号为 $*i*$ 的电视机售价为 $*a*_{*i*}$ 贝拉。有些电视机的价格为负数——它们的所有者愿意在鲍勃买下这些无用设备时付钱给他。鲍勃可以“购买”任意数量、任意选择的电视机。尽管鲍勃力气很大，但他最多只能搬运 $*m*$ 台电视机，并且不想再次前往售卖活动现场。请帮助鲍勃求出他最多能赚到的钱数。

## 输入格式

第一行包含两个用空格分隔的整数 $*n*$ 和 $*m*$（$1 ≤ *m* ≤ *n* ≤ 100$），分别表示售卖活动中的电视机数量，以及鲍勃最多能搬运的电视机数量。下一行包含 $*n*$ 个用空格分隔的整数 $*a*_{*i*}$（$- 1000 ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ 1000$），表示各台电视机的价格。

## 输出格式

输出一个整数，即在鲍勃最多搬运 $*m*$ 台电视机的情况下，他最多能赚到的钱数。
</statement>
